newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Corpgro busy in "normal" speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Corpgro busy in "normal" speculative trade.

text.p: Shares in South African industrial group Corpgro Ltd were the most active securities on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange by volume early on Thursday, but dealers said the small capitalisation stock was often heavily traded.
"There is often a lot of stock around. Corpgro regularly trades between five and 10 million shares on a single day. It is just speculative interest," one dealer said.
By 0834 GMT almost two million Corpgro shares had traded and the share price added a cent to 28 cents.
Corpgro earlier this month switched its listing to the "Industrial-Holdings" on the Johannesburg bourse from its previous home in the "Industrial-Stores" to better reflect the company's activities.
In the six months to end March the acquisitive firm, which owns hardware, building supplies and a signs business, reported a rise in earnings per share to 1.31 cents from 0.64 cents before.
